finding: Schema validation copied ancestor paths and joined a column string at every node, checked group nodes twice, and recursed while skipping unselected subtrees. Deep selected schemas incurred quadratic path work and could overflow the JS call stack.
change: One iterative traversal with a mutable path and remaining-child stack; subtree skipping uses a pending-node counter. Column strings are constructed only for rejected leaves. Workspace is O(depth), traversal is O(schema nodes), excluding the one error-path string.
limitations: Synthetic schema-only timings do not measure whole queries, IO, codec costs or VM heap usage.

Schema workspace is charged on the listed budget-aware paths; borrowed callers without a budget remain untracked. Error-message strings and other metadata/planner allocations are outside this workspace model.
Other schema consumers may still recurse. This change does not establish support for arbitrary nesting throughout query execution.

allocationAdmission.change: Temporary selection Set, path array, and remaining-child stack are admitted before allocation/growth. Geometric capacity growth needs logarithmically many reservations and stays bounded by schema size. Validation scope releases on success, unsupported schema, or budget failure. Empty projection returns before traversal.
allocationAdmission.callers: Scan adapters (including owned indexed/cached multi-file discovery), aggregate/task scans, and owned indexed task planning propagate the caller budget.
